children: Wynn Resorts announced a private offering of $900 million senior notes due 2035 to finance redemption of its 2027 Wynn Las Vegas notes.
Issuers to offer $900 million aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2035 in a private placement.
Net proceeds plus cash on hand will be contributed or lent to Wynn Las Vegas to redeem in full the 5.250% senior notes due 2027.
Notes will be senior unsecured, jointly and severally guaranteed by domestic guarantor subsidiaries and rank equal with other non‑subordinated liabilities.
Notes will be effectively subordinated to secured debt and will be offered only to qualified institutional buyers or outside the U.S. under Regulation S.
Proceeds will also cover fees and expenses related to the issuance and the redemption of the 2027 Wynn Las Vegas notes.
